historical_cutoff: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 10 (2026-11-16); no Week 11 games included
sportsbook: FanDuel primary; no DraftKings fallback required for these alternate markets

method.core: Select an available FanDuel alternate with American odds from -350 through -150 inclusive; choose odds numerically closest to -250; ties resolve to the more negative price.
method.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
method.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE.
method.alternate_historical_hr: Hits / 10, calculated from the exact locked Stage 1 L10 observations using value >= alternate threshold.
method.candidate_narrowing: Carry forward only records with a CORE and either CORE or FLOOR historical HR >= 7/10, aligning with the model's minimum 70% L[N] requirement for final portfolio legs. Exclude records with no CORE or neither CORE nor FLOOR meeting 7/10.
method.stage2_context_research: Not performed. Matchup, injury, workload, role, weather, and other current-week context are reserved for Stage 3.
